# Claude Code — Bootstrap Order

```text
P0 → P1 → P2 → P3 → Master Assets → Integration Tests → P4
```

## First commands
- inspect repository tree
- merge package dependencies rather than overwriting
- preserve existing env files
- create `.env.example`, never commit secrets
- add lab routes
- run typecheck/lint/tests after each layer
- record incompatible upstream API changes in an ADR
